name: benign_real_bank_call
label: benign
description: The real bank calls about a suspicious charge and does everything right: asks her to confirm a purchase, says it will never ask for codes, and tells her to call the number on the back of her card. Bank-call shaped, but no request for money, access or secrecy.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Hello, this is Riverbend Community Bank calling about a card purchase of two hundred and twelve dollars at an electronics store this morning. Did you make that purchase?

call.speaker: senior
call.text: No, I didn't buy anything today.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: Thank you. We've blocked the card and a new one will arrive by post. We will never ask you for a code or a password over the phone.

call.speaker: caller
call.text: If you'd like to check this call is genuine, hang up and call the number on the back of your card.

call.speaker: senior
call.text: Thank you, I will do that.
